chew.definition:
n. a wad of something chewable as tobacco
n. biting and grinding food in your mouth so it becomes soft enough to swallow
v. chew (food); to bite and grind with the teeth
chew.translation:
vt. 咀嚼, 嚼碎
vi. 咀嚼, 细想
n. 咀嚼, 咀嚼物

chew the rag.translation: 聊天, 争论, 发牢骚

chew up.translation: 充分咀嚼; 弄坏; 罚;  申斥

chewa.translation: [网络] 切瓦人；瓦族；契瓦文

chewable.definition: s. easy to cut or chew

chewed.definition: v chew (food); to bite and grind with the teeth
chewed.translation: v. 咀嚼, 咬( chew的过去式和过去分词 ); （因为紧张等）咬住, 不停地啃, （为尝味道）不停地咀嚼

chewer.definition: n. someone who chews (especially someone who chews tobacco)
chewer.translation: n. 反刍动物；咀嚼口香糖的人

chewers.definition:
plural of chewer
n. someone who chews (especially someone who chews tobacco)
chewers.translation: (chewer 的复数) n. 反刍动物；咀嚼口香糖的人

chewie.translation: n. <澳口>胶姆糖,口香糖,橡皮糖

chewier.definition:
s. requiring much chewing
s. (of a consistency) requiring chewing
chewier.translation: a. （食物）耐嚼的, 不易嚼碎的( chewy的比较级 )

chewiest.definition:
s. requiring much chewing
s. (of a consistency) requiring chewing
chewiest.translation: a. （食物）耐嚼的, 不易嚼碎的( chewy的最高级 )

chewing.definition:
n biting and grinding food in your mouth so it becomes soft enough to swallow
v chew (food); to bite and grind with the teeth

chewing-stick.translation: 咀嚼洁齿棒（用于非洲和亚洲的一些地区, 取材于植物根茎）

chewings.definition:
plural of chewing
n biting and grinding food in your mouth so it becomes soft enough to swallow
v chew (food); to bite and grind with the teeth

chewink.definition: n. common towhee of eastern North America

chews.definition:
n a wad of something chewable as tobacco
n biting and grinding food in your mouth so it becomes soft enough to swallow
v chew (food); to bite and grind with the teeth
chews.translation: v. 咀嚼, 咬( chew的第三人称单数 ); （因为紧张等）咬住, 不停地啃, （为尝味道）不停地咀嚼; 中粒煤

chewy.definition:
s. requiring much chewing
s. (of a consistency) requiring chewing
chewy.translation: a. 需要多嚼的, 难嚼的
